agent: Agent 3 - Real YouTube/TikTok Source Video Edit Lineage

root_cause_incident_analysis.user_prompt: analise e edite esse video em ingles https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FV93IVwJP_4
root_cause_incident_analysis.casing_defect: Agent mistakenly probed lowercase l ('FV93lVwJP_4') and received 404, assuming unavailable. Uppercase I ('FV93IVwJP_4') is an active 1115s 4K video by TGG.
root_cause_incident_analysis.ingestion_defect: yt-dlp downloaded AV01/Opus streams and output .webm/.mkv despite -o filename.mp4, causing FileNotFoundError. Added format flags, merge-output-format mp4, and automatic ffmpeg remux fallback.
root_cause_incident_analysis.python_environment_defect: Python 3.14 on host had yt-dlp executable on PATH but no yt_dlp python package. Added subprocess CLI fallback inside ytdlp_service.py.

agent5_integration_guide.recommended_call_pattern: adapter = EditExistingMediaAdapter(); intent = adapter.classify_intent(user_prompt); if intent != EditIntentType.NEW_SYNTHETIC_GENERATION: contract = await adapter.prepare_contract(prompt, source_url); result = await adapter.execute_edit(contract); ...
